upgrade.gi_fortifications.name: Fiber-Reinforced Fortifications
upgrade.gi_fortifications.description:
Increases movement speed of G.I.s and Guardian G.I.s by 25%.
Deployed G.I.s become uncrushable.

upgrade.a2a_missiles.name: Air-to-Air Missile Systems
upgrade.a2a_missiles.description: Enables Harriers to target enemy aircraft.

upgrade.advanced_coolants.name: Advanced Coolants
upgrade.advanced_coolants.description: Doubles the power output of Power Plants.

upgrade.advanced_training.name: Advanced Training
upgrade.advanced_training.description:
The following units gain experience 50% faster:
- G.I.
- Guardian G.I.
- Grenadier
- Rocketeer
- Navy SEAL
- Tanya Adams
- Chrono Commando

upgrade.predator_missiles.name: Predator Missiles
upgrade.predator_missiles.description: Increases the damage of Harriers by 25%.

upgrade.composite_armor.name: Composite Armor
upgrade.composite_armor.description:
Increases the durability of the following units by 33%:
- Grizzly Tank
- Ambulance
- Tank Destroyer
- Mirage Tank
- Battle Fortress

upgrade.boost_gliding_systems.name: Boost-Gliding Systems
upgrade.boost_gliding_systems.description:
America's finest technology that increases the projectile speed and damage of the following units by 50%:
- Patriot Missile System
- Guardian G.I.
- Infantry Fighting Vehicle
- Aegis Cruiser
- Chrono Dragon

upgrade.portable_weaponry.name: Portable Weaponry
upgrade.portable_weaponry.description:
Through tough British drilling G.I.s and Guardian G.I.s are now capable of
using their deployed weapon while mobile.
While deployed they fire 25% faster.

upgrade.grand_cannon_protocols.name: Grand Cannon Protocols
upgrade.grand_cannon_protocols.description:
French defense protocol that allows the construction of the Grand Cannon.
Increases durability of Walls, Gates and Defences by 15%.

upgrade.advanced_gun_systems.name: Advanced Gun Systems
upgrade.advanced_gun_systems.description: Superior German weapon design increases the attack range of Grizzly Tanks and Tank Destroyers by 25%.

upgrade.emp_munitions.name: EMP Munitions
upgrade.emp_munitions.description: Korean invention that arms Grenadiers and Howitzers with EMP munitions which disable vehicles and buildings.

upgrade.increased_payload.name: Increased Payload
upgrade.increased_payload.description: Doubles the payload of B2 Spirits from 5 to 10.

upgrade.ap_bullets.name: Armor-Piercing Bullets
upgrade.ap_bullets.description:
Improves the damage of the following units by 25%:
- Sentry Gun
- Conscript
- Boris Bukov
- War Miner
- Siege Chopper

upgrade.bullet_proof_coats.name: Bullet-Proof Coats
upgrade.bullet_proof_coats.description: Increases durability of Conscripts and Flak Troopers by 33%.

upgrade.molotov_cocktails.name: Molotov Cocktails
upgrade.molotov_cocktails.description: Provides Conscripts with Molotov Coctails which increase their damage against structures.

upgrade.nuclear_engines.name: Nuclear Engines
upgrade.nuclear_engines.description:
Increases the movement speed of the following units:
- Rhino Tanks by 14%
- Apocalypse Tanks by 20%
Both units will explode violently and leave radiation when destroyed.

upgrade.uranium_shells.name: Depleted Uranium Shells
upgrade.uranium_shells.description: Increases the damage of Rhino and Apocalypse Tanks by 25%.

upgrade.overcharge.name: Overcharge
upgrade.overcharge.description: Formidable Russian technology that enables Tesla weapons to disable enemy vehicles for a short time.

upgrade.advanced_irradiators.name: Advanced Irradiators
upgrade.advanced_irradiators.description: Devastating Iraqi fallout program that increases the damage of radiation by 50%.

upgrade.black_napalm.name: Black Napalm
upgrade.black_napalm.description:
Vietnamese technology leaves nothing but scorched earth.
Doubles the damage of the following units:
- Flame Tank
- Black Kite

upgrade.targeted_explosives.name: Targeted Explosives
upgrade.targeted_explosives.description:
Cuban safety protocols minimize any damage caused by explosions to your own army.
Explosions caused by Terrorists, Death Bombs and Crazy Ivans no longer damage friendly units.
Increases Terrorist and Death Bombs area of effect by 50%.

upgrade.high_explosive_bombs.name: High Explosive Bombs
upgrade.high_explosive_bombs.description:
Libyan chemical mixture that increases the damage of the following units by 25%:
- Crazy Ivan
- Chrono Ivan
- Mortar Cycle
- Demolition Truck
- V3 Launcher
- Dreadnought

upgrade.radioactive_bombs.name: Fallout Warheads
upgrade.radioactive_bombs.description: Makes Kirov, V3 Launcher and Dreadnought projectiles leave radiation.
